🔥 Constrict | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Compressing video files to meet specific size limits for uploads or storage, without manual trial-and-error.
✨ Key Features: • Compress videos to target file sizes • Automatic calculation of ABR, resolution, framerate, and audio quality • Bulk compression • Customizable framerate limits • Choice of codecs (H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP9)
📖 Summary: Constrict is a desktop application for Linux that allows users to compress video files to a target file size. It automatically calculates the necessary encoding parameters like bitrate, resolution, and framerate to achieve the desired output size while aiming to preserve audiovisual quality.
